title: O‘tgan dam olish haqida hikoya qilish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida o‘tgan sayohat yoki dam olishingiz haqida first, then, after that, finally kabi so‘zlar bilan tartibli, o‘tgan zamonda va his-tuyg‘ularingizni bildirib, bir daqiqa davomida hikoya qilib bera olasiz.

scenes.title: O‘tgan sayohat haqida hikoya
board: Lesson: Telling a story about a holiday
scenes.say: Hello again! Last time we learned irregular verbs. Today you will tell a story about a holiday or a trip, in the correct order, with your feelings.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda noto‘g‘ri fe’llarning o‘tgan shaklini va did bilan savol, inkor tuzishni o‘rgandik. Bugun bu bilimni amalda ishlatamiz: o‘tgan dam olishingiz yoki sayohatingiz haqida tartib bilan, ya’ni “avval, keyin, undan so‘ng, oxirida” kabi so‘zlar bilan hikoya qilasiz va his-tuyg‘ularingizni ifodalaysiz. Dars oxirida bir daqiqa to‘xtamay gapira olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! O‘tgan safar noto‘g‘ri fe’llarni o‘rgandik. Bugun dam olish yoki sayohat haqida to‘g‘ri tartibda, his-tuyg‘ular bilan hikoya qilasiz.

scenes.title: Yaxshi hikoya tuzilishi
scenes.say: A good story has three parts. First, where, when and who with. Then, what happened. Finally, how you felt.
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi hikoya uch qismdan iborat. Birinchi qism: qayerga, qachon va kim bilan borganingiz. Ikkinchi qism: nimalar bo‘lgani, ya’ni voqealar tartibi. Uchinchi qism: o‘zingizni qanday his qilganingiz va sayohat sizga yoqqanmi. O‘zbek tilida hikoyani ko‘pincha qisqa boshlaymiz, ingliz tilida esa tinglovchi uchun aniq tartib juda muhim. Shuning uchun bugun har bir qism uchun tayyor iboralarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi hikoya uch qismdan iborat. Avval qayerga, qachon va kim bilan. Keyin nima bo‘lgani. Oxirida o‘zingizni qanday his qilganingiz.

scenes.title: Hikoyani boshlash

examples.t: Last summer I went to Turkey.
Two years ago we visited Samarkand.
In July I travelled to Dubai with my sister.

scenes.say: Last summer I went to Turkey. Two years ago we visited Samarkand. In July I travelled to Dubai with my sister.
scenes.say_native: Hikoyani vaqt iborasi bilan boshlang: “last summer” — o‘tgan yozda, “two years ago” — ikki yil oldin, “in July” — iyulda. E’tibor bering: “ago” har doim vaqtdan keyin keladi, “two years ago”, “ago two years” emas. “Last” oldida predlog yo‘q: “last summer”, “in last summer” emas. Ingliz tilida “holiday” britaniyalik varianti, amerikaliklar esa “vacation” deydi, ma’nosi bir xil.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan yozda Turkiyaga bordim. Ikki yil oldin Samarqandga bordik. Iyulda singlim bilan Dubayga bordim.

scenes.title: Hikoya boshlanishi
board: Last August I went to the sea with my family.
We stayed in a small hotel near the beach.
scenes.say: Last August I went to the sea with my family. We travelled by plane and stayed in a small hotel near the beach. It was a lovely place.
scenes.say_native: Mana yaxshi boshlanish namunasi. Bir gapda vaqt, joy va hamrohlar aytildi, ikkinchi gapda transport va turar joy, uchinchi gapda qisqa baho. Aytgancha, “by plane” da artikl yo‘q: transport vositasi umumiy ma’noda, “by train”, “by bus”, “by car”. Lekin “in a small hotel” da artikl bor, chunki bu aniq bir mehmonxona emas, shunchaki bitta mehmonxona.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan avgustda oilam bilan dengizga bordim. Samolyotda bordik va plyaj yaqinidagi kichik mehmonxonada turdik. Bu yoqimli joy edi.

scenes.title: Sayohat lug‘ati: transport
scenes.say: We booked the tickets online. The flight was long. My luggage was heavy, but I did not lose my passport.
scenes.say_native: Sayohat lug‘atidan boshlaymiz. “Flight” — havo reysi, “coach” — uzoq masofali avtobus, “ferry” — kema yoki parom. “Ticket” — chipta, “passport” — pasport, “luggage” — yuk. Diqqat: “luggage” sanalmaydigan ot, “a luggage” yoki “luggages” demaymiz, “my luggage” deymiz. Amerikaliklar “baggage” ham ishlatadi. “Book” ni “kitob” deb tarjima qilmang: bu yerda fe’l, ya’ni oldindan band qilish.
scenes.say_uz: Biz chiptalarni onlayn band qildik. Reys uzoq bo‘ldi. Yukim og‘ir edi, lekin pasportni yo‘qotmadim.

scenes.title: Sayohat lug‘ati: joylar
scenes.say: We stayed in a hostel near the old town. We visited the museum and the market. The beach was empty, and the mountains were beautiful.
scenes.say_native: Endi joylar. “Hotel” — mehmonxona, “hostel” — arzon yotoqxona turidagi turar joy, “campsite” — chodir qurib turiladigan joy. Tabiat: “beach” — plyaj, “mountains” — tog‘lar, “lake” — ko‘l. Shahar: “museum”, “market”, “old town” — eski shahar. “Sights” — diqqatga sazovor joylar, “go sightseeing” — shaharni tomosha qilish. Bu so‘zlarni gapda bilib oling, ro‘yxatni emas.
scenes.say_uz: Biz eski shahar yaqinidagi yotoqxonada turdik. Muzey va bozorni ko‘rdik. Plyaj bo‘sh edi, tog‘lar chiroyli edi.

scenes.title: Sayohat fe‘llari
scenes.say: I packed my bag. We arrived at midnight. We checked in, rented bikes and explored the city. In the evening we relaxed.
scenes.say_native: Sayohat fe’llari: “pack” — yuk yig‘moq, “arrive” — yetib kelmoq, “check in” — mehmonxonada ro‘yxatdan o‘tmoq, “rent” — ijaraga olmoq, “explore” — o‘rganmoq, kashf qilmoq, “relax” — dam olmoq. Barchasi muntazam fe’llar, o‘tgan zamonda “-ed” oladi: packed, arrived, checked in, rented, explored, relaxed. Bu so‘zlar sayohat hikoyasining asosiy qismi, shuning uchun ularni hikoyada ishlatishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say_uz: Sumkamni yig‘dim. Yarim tunda yetib keldik. Ro‘yxatdan o‘tdik, velosipedlar ijaraga oldik va shaharni kezdik. Kechqurun dam oldik.

scenes.title: So‘zni toping
board: 1) We stayed in a ___ by the sea. (hotel / ticket)
2) I booked a ___ to London. (flight / beach)
4) We ___ at the airport at noon. (arrived / relaxed)
scenes.say: Choose the right word. We stayed in a hotel or ticket by the sea? I booked a flight or beach to London? My luggage or museum was very heavy? We arrived or relaxed at the airport at noon?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir gapda to‘g‘ri so‘zni tanlang. Birinchi: dengiz bo‘yida hotel yoki ticket? Ikkinchi: Londonga flight yoki beach band qildim? Uchinchi: yuk, ya’ni luggage yoki museum og‘ir edi? To‘rtinchi: aeroportga arrived yoki relaxed? Javobni gapni to‘liq aytib bering.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri so‘zni tanlang. Dengiz bo‘yidagi hotel yoki ticket? Londonga flight yoki beach? Luggage yoki museum og‘ir edi? Aeroportga arrived yoki relaxed?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: A hotel. A flight. Luggage. Arrived.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchisida “hotel”, chunki mehmonxonada turamiz, chipta emas. Ikkinchisida “flight”, reysga chipta band qilinadi. Uchinchisida “luggage”, yuk og‘ir bo‘ladi, muzey emas. To‘rtinchisida “arrived”, chunki aeroportga yetib kelamiz, u yerda dam olmaymiz. Birinchi qadam bajarildi: endi voqealarni tartibga solish vositalarini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Mehmonxona. Reys. Yuk. Yetib keldik.

scenes.title: Tartib so‘zlari

examples.t: Then we went to the beach.

scenes.say: First, we checked in. Then we went to the beach. After that, we had lunch. Finally, we went home.
scenes.say_native: Hikoya tinglovchi uchun tushunarli bo‘lishi uchun voqealarni tartib so‘zlari bilan bog‘laymiz. “First” — avval, “then” yoki “next” — keyin, “after that” — undan so‘ng, “finally” — nihoyat, oxirida. O‘zbek tilida biz ko‘pincha “keyin” so‘zini takrorlayvermaymiz, ingliz tilida esa so‘zlar bu yerda majburiy emas, lekin ular hikoyani silliq qiladi. Bir hikoyada “then” ni besh marta qaytarmang, uni “next”, “after that” bilan almashtiring.
scenes.say_uz: Avval ro‘yxatdan o‘tdik. Keyin plyajga bordik. Undan so‘ng tushlik qildik. Nihoyat uyga qaytdik.

scenes.title: Tartib so‘zlari: joyi va vergul
board: We ate, and then we walked.
We then went home. (Then — fe’ldan oldin)

examples.t: We ate, and then we walked.

scenes.say: First, I packed. Next, I called a taxi. After that, I went to the airport. We ate, and then we walked.
scenes.say_native: Tartib so‘zi gap boshida kelsa, undan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi: “First, I packed.” “After that, I went…”. “Then” ni gap o‘rtasida ham ishlatsa bo‘ladi: “We ate, and then we walked.” Bu yerda “and” ikki harakatni bog‘laydi. Eslatma: “after” bilan “after that” farqlanadi. “After the lunch” emas, “after lunch” — tushlikdan keyin, “after that” esa oldingi gapga qaytadi: “undan keyin”.
scenes.say_uz: Avval sumkamni yig‘dim. Keyin taksi chaqirdim. So‘ng aeroportga bordim. Ovqatlandik, keyin sayr qildik.

scenes.title: Tartib bilan hikoya
board: After that, we visited the Blue Mosque.
scenes.say: First, we flew to Istanbul. It was a short flight. Then we took a ferry across the water. After that, we visited the Blue Mosque and the market. Finally, we ate fresh fish by the sea.
scenes.say_native: Eshiting: bu qisqa hikoyada to‘rtta tartib so‘zi ishlatilgan: first, then, after that, finally. Har bir gapda bitta asosiy voqea. Agar ko‘zingizni yumib tinglasangiz, hikoya tartibini aniq tasavvur qilasiz. Mana shunday aniq tartib so‘zlari sizning gapirishingizni tabiiy va ishonarli qiladi. Hikoya o‘tgan zamonda: flew, took, visited, ate.
scenes.say_uz: Avval Istanbulga uchib bordik. Reys qisqa edi. Keyin suv narigi tomoniga paromga chiqdik. So‘ng Ko‘k masjid va bozorni ko‘rdik. Nihoyat dengiz bo‘yida yangi baliq yedik.

scenes.title: At first, in the end, at last
board: ✗ At the first, it was cold.
scenes.say: Finally, we went home. Not in finally. At first it was cold, but then it was sunny. In the end, we were happy.
scenes.say_native: Bir nechta xato. “In finally” emas, faqat “Finally”. “At the first” emas, “At first” — dastlab, boshida; u “first” bilan bir xil emas. “First” hikoyadagi birinchi qadamni bildiradi, “at first” esa keyingi o‘zgarishga ishora qiladi: “At first it was cold, but then it was sunny”. “In the end” — oxir-oqibat, uzoq jarayondan keyin. Bularni bir-biridan farqlang, chunki o‘zbekcha “avval” hamma uchun ishlatiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Finally, we went home. In finally emas. Dastlab sovuq edi, lekin keyin quyoshli bo‘ldi. Oxir-oqibat xursand edik.

scenes.title: Gaplarni tartibga soling
board: b) First, we went to the airport.
c) After that, we flew to Rome.
scenes.say: Put the sentences in order. A, finally we got home. B, first we went to the airport. C, after that we flew to Rome. D, then we checked in.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Taxtadagi to‘rtta gapni to‘g‘ri tartibga soling. Gaplar: a — nihoyat uyga yetib keldik; b — avval aeroportga bordik; c — undan so‘ng Rimga uchib bordik; d — keyin ro‘yxatdan o‘tdik. Tartib so‘zlariga qarab harflarni ayting va keyin hikoyani butunlay ovoz chiqarib o‘qing.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni tartibga soling. A, nihoyat uyga yetdik. B, avval aeroportga bordik. C, so‘ng Rimga uchdik. D, keyin ro‘yxatdan o‘tdik.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: First, we went to the airport.
Then we checked in. After that, we flew to Rome. Finally, we got home.
scenes.say: First, we went to the airport. Then we checked in. After that, we flew to Rome. Finally, we got home.
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri tartib: b, d, c, a. Avval aeroportga bordik, keyin ro‘yxatdan o‘tdik, undan so‘ng Rimga uchdik, nihoyat uyga yetib keldik. Ko‘ryapsizmi, mantiq yordam beradi: “first” boshida, “finally” oxirida. Endi bu tartibli hikoyani o‘tgan zamon fe’llari bilan to‘ldirish haqida gaplashamiz, chunki yaxshi hikoya faqat tartib so‘zlari emas.
scenes.say_uz: Avval aeroportga bordik. Keyin ro‘yxatdan o‘tdik. So‘ng Rimga uchib bordik. Nihoyat uyga yetdik.

scenes.title: Hikoyada o‘tgan zamon

examples.t: We arrived, put our bags down and went out.
examples.uz: Yetib keldik, sumkalarni qo‘yib, tashqariga chiqdik.

scenes.say: We arrived, put our bags down and went out. We walked along the river, took photos and had dinner.
scenes.say_native: Hikoya qilganda voqealar ketma-ketligi o‘tgan oddiy zamonda aytiladi. Muntazam fe’llar: arrived, walked, visited, stayed. Noto‘g‘ri fe’llar: went, saw, ate, took, had, put. Bir gapda bir necha fe’lni “and” bilan bog‘lab, ularni ketma-ket aytsa bo‘ladi, bunda yordamchi so‘z yoki ega takrorlanmaydi: “We walked, took photos and had dinner”. O‘zbek tilida bu ravishdosh bilan ifodalanadi: “yurib, rasm olib, kechki ovqat qildik”.
scenes.say_uz: Yetib keldik, sumkalarni qo‘yib, tashqariga chiqdik. Daryo bo‘ylab yurdik, rasmlar oldik va kechki ovqat qildik.

scenes.title: Tavsif uchun was / were
board: There was a pool. / There were a lot of tourists.

examples.t: There were many people on the beach.

scenes.say: The hotel was small. The rooms were clean. The weather was hot. There was a pool, and there were many tourists.
scenes.say_native: Tavsif uchun “was” va “were” ishlatiladi. “Was” — I, he, she, it bilan; “were” — you, we, they bilan. “The hotel was small. The rooms were clean.” Joy tavsifi uchun “there was” birlikda va “there were” ko‘plikda: “There was a pool”, “There were many tourists”. Esda tuting: voqea uchun harakat fe’li, tavsif uchun “was” yoki “were”. Savol va inkor: “Was it hot?” — “No, it wasn’t.” Bu yerda “did” kerak emas.
scenes.say_uz: Mehmonxona kichik edi. Xonalar toza edi. Ob-havo issiq edi. Hovuz bor edi va ko‘p turistlar bor edi.

scenes.title: Gaplarni bog‘lash

examples.t: It was hot, so we swam.
We wanted to see it, but it was closed.
examples.uz: Uni ko‘rmoqchi edik, lekin yopiq edi.

scenes.say: It was hot, so we swam. We wanted to see the castle, but it was closed. We stayed there because the food was good.
scenes.say_native: Gaplarni bog‘lovchilar bilan uzib-ulab qo‘shsangiz, nutq ravonlashadi. “And” — va, “but” — lekin, “so” — shuning uchun, natijani bildiradi, “because” — chunki, sababni bildiradi. “It was hot, so we swam” — issiq edi, shuning uchun suzdik. “We stayed because the food was good” — qoldik, chunki ovqat yaxshi edi. “So” oldida vergul bo‘ladi. Sabab va natijani adashtirmang: “because” sababni, “so” natijani bildiradi.
scenes.say_uz: Issiq edi, shuning uchun suzdik. Qasrni ko‘rmoqchi edik, lekin yopiq edi. Ovqat yaxshi bo‘lgani uchun u yerda qoldik.

scenes.title: Zamonni aralashtirish
board: ✗ Last summer I go to Turkey.
✓ Last summer I went to Turkey.
✗ We arrived and we go to the hotel.
✓ We arrived and we went to the hotel.
scenes.say: Last summer I went to Turkey. We arrived and went to the hotel. Not I was went. Not I go.
scenes.say_native: Hikoya o‘tgan zamonda boshlangan bo‘lsa, oxirigacha shunday davom etadi. Ko‘p o‘quvchi o‘zbekchadagi tarzda hozirgi zamonga o‘tib ketadi, chunki o‘zbek tilida hikoya ba’zan hozirgi zamonda ham aytiladi: “Boraman, ko‘raman”. Ingliz tilida bu g‘alati eshitiladi. Yana bir xato: “I was went”, ya’ni “was” bilan “went” aralashtirilishi. To‘g‘risi: “I went”. Bir gapda faqat bitta o‘tgan zamon shakli kerak.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan yozda Turkiyaga bordim. Yetib keldik va mehmonxonaga bordik. I was went emas. I go emas.

scenes.title: Matnni o‘tgan zamonga o‘tkazing
board: We (arrive) at six. We (go) to the hotel and (have) dinner. Then we (walk) by the sea.
scenes.say: Put the verbs in the past. We arrive at six. We go to the hotel and have dinner. Then we walk by the sea.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Qavs ichidagi fe’llarni o‘tgan zamonga o‘tkazib, matnni to‘liq o‘qing: soat oltida yetib keldik, mehmonxonaga bordik, kechki ovqat qildik, keyin dengiz bo‘ylab sayr qildik. Beshta fe’l bor, ularning ichida uchtasi noto‘g‘ri. Qaysilari?
scenes.say_uz: Fe’llarni o‘tgan zamonga qo‘ying. Oltida yetib keldik. Mehmonxonaga borib, kechki ovqat qildik. Keyin dengiz bo‘ylab yurdik.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: We went to the hotel and had dinner.
Then we walked by the sea.
scenes.say: We arrived at six. We went to the hotel and had dinner. Then we walked by the sea.
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri matn: “We arrived at six. We went to the hotel and had dinner. Then we walked by the sea.” Noto‘g‘ri fe’llar: go — went va have — had. Muntazam fe’llar: arrive — arrived va walk — walked. Bu yerda ikkita noto‘g‘ri fe’l bor, muntazam fe’llar ham ikkita. Agar hammasi to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, ajoyib! Endi sayohat hikoyasining yuragi — his-tuyg‘ular haqida gaplashamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Oltida yetib keldik. Mehmonxonaga borib, kechki ovqat qildik. Keyin dengiz bo‘ylab yurdik.

scenes.title: His-tuyg‘u so‘zlari: -ed va -ing
board: I was excited / bored / tired / surprised.
The trip was amazing / boring / tiring.

examples.t: I was excited about the trip.

scenes.say: I was excited. The trip was exciting. I was bored. The film was boring. I was tired. The journey was tiring.
scenes.say_native: Muhim juftliklar: “excited — exciting”, “bored — boring”, “tired — tiring”, “surprised — surprising”. “-ed” bilan tugagan sifat insonning his-tuyg‘usini bildiradi: “I was bored” — men zerikdim. “-ing” bilan tugagan sifat narsa yoki voqeaning xususiyatini bildiradi: “The film was boring” — film zerikarli edi. O‘zbek tilida “zerikdim” va “zerikarli” boshqa so‘z, ingliz tilida esa bitta o‘zak, faqat oxiri farq qiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Men hayajonda edim. Sayohat hayajonli edi. Zerikdim. Film zerikarli edi. Charchadim. Yo‘l charchatuvchi edi.

scenes.title: I was boring?
board: ✗ I was boring at the museum.
✓ I was bored at the museum.
scenes.say: I was bored at the museum, not boring. The trip was exciting, not excited.
scenes.say_native: Juda keng tarqalgan xato: “I was boring”. Bu degani “men zerikarli odam edim”, ya’ni siz boshqalarni zeriktirgansiz. “I was bored” esa “men zerikdim”. Xuddi shunday “The trip was excited” noto‘g‘ri, chunki sayohat hayajonlana olmaydi: “The trip was exciting”. Qoida: kim his qilsa — “-ed”, nima sababchi bo‘lsa — “-ing”. Rus tilidan bilganlar uchun: “Мне скучно” va “скучный” kabi farq.
scenes.say_uz: Muzeyda zerikdim. Sayohat hayajonli edi. I was boring emas. The trip was excited emas.

scenes.title: -ed yoki -ing?
board: 2) I was (tired / tiring) after the flight.
4) We were (surprised / surprising) by the price.
scenes.say: Choose. The beach was amazed or amazing? I was tired or tiring after the flight? The tour was boring or bored? We were surprised or surprising by the price?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir gapda to‘g‘ri shaklni tanlang. Birinchi: plyaj amazed yoki amazing? Ikkinchi: parvozdan keyin men tired yoki tiring edim? Uchinchi: ekskursiya boring yoki bored? To‘rtinchi: narxdan biz surprised yoki surprising edik? Agar kim his qilayotganini o‘ylasangiz, osonlashadi.
scenes.say_uz: Tanlang. Plyaj amazed yoki amazing? Parvozdan keyin tired yoki tiring? Ekskursiya boring yoki bored? Narxdan surprised yoki surprising?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: The beach was amazing. I was tired after the flight. The tour was boring. We were surprised by the price.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “amazing”, chunki plyaj sabab. “Tired”, chunki men his qilgan odamman. “Boring”, chunki ekskursiya zerikarli bo‘lgan. “Surprised”, chunki biz narxdan hayron bo‘ldik. Yana bir foydali bilim: his-tuyg‘u sifatlaridan keyin “about”, “by” yoki “with” kelishi mumkin: “excited about”, “surprised by”, “bored with”. Hozircha bularni gap ichida yodlang.
scenes.say_uz: Plyaj ajoyib edi. Parvozdan keyin charchagan edim. Ekskursiya zerikarli edi. Narxdan hayron bo‘ldik.

scenes.title: Fikr va tuyg‘uni ifodalash

examples.t: The best thing was the weather.

scenes.say: I really enjoyed the food. My favourite part was the boat trip. The best thing was the weather. The hotel was not very good because it was noisy.
scenes.say_native: Fikringizni bildirish uchun tayyor iboralar: “I loved…” — menga juda yoqdi, “I really enjoyed…” — rosa zavqlandim, “My favourite part was…” — eng sevimli qismi… edi, “The best thing was…” — eng yaxshi narsa… edi. Salbiy fikr uchun: “It wasn’t very good because…”. Bu yumshoq va odobli. Diqqat: “I enjoyed” dan keyin ot yoki fe’l-ing keladi: “I enjoyed swimming”, “I enjoyed to swim” emas.
scenes.say_uz: Ovqat menga juda yoqdi. Eng sevimli qismi qayiqda sayr edi. Eng yaxshisi ob-havo edi. Mehmonxona yaxshi emas edi, chunki shovqinli edi.

scenes.title: Dialog 1: Istanbul haqida
board: B: It was amazing! We went to Istanbul.
A: What did you do there?
B: We visited museums and ate delicious food.
scenes.say: How was your holiday? It was amazing! We went to Istanbul for a week. What did you do there? First, we visited the museums. Then we took a boat trip. The best thing was the food. It was delicious! Did you like the weather? Yes, it was warm and sunny.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Ikki do‘st ta’til haqida gaplashmoqda. Sizning vazifangiz: kim qayerga borgan, qancha vaqt va nima eng yoqqan. Dialogda ko‘p narsa bor: “How was…?” — qanday o‘tdi, tartib so‘zlari, his-tuyg‘u so‘zlari va savol-javob. Tinglang va quyidagi savollarga tayyorlaning.
scenes.say_uz: Ta’tilingiz qanday o‘tdi? Ajoyib! Bir haftaga Istanbulga bordik. U yerda nima qildingiz? Avval muzeylarni ko‘rdik. Keyin qayiqda sayr qildik. Eng yaxshisi ovqat edi. Mazali edi! Ob-havo yoqdimi? Ha, iliq va quyoshli edi.

scenes.title: Dialog 1 haqida savollar
scenes.say: Where did B go? How long was the trip? What was the best thing?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: B qayerga bordi? Ikkinchi: sayohat qancha davom etdi? Uchinchi: eng yaxshi narsa nima bo‘ldi? Ham to‘liq gap bilan, ham qisqa ayting, farqi yo‘q. Muhimi, javobni eshitgandan topasiz.
scenes.say_uz: B qayerga bordi? Sayohat qancha davom etdi? Eng yaxshi narsa nima edi?

scenes.title: Dialog 1: javoblar
scenes.say: B went to Istanbul. The trip was a week. The best thing was the food.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: B Istanbulga bordi. Sayohat bir hafta davom etdi. Eng yaxshi narsa ovqat bo‘ldi. Yana bir jihatga e’tibor bering: muloqotdagi savolga javob berganda “It was amazing!” kabi qisqa baho bilan boshlash tabiiy. Keyin tafsilotlar qo‘shiladi: nima bo‘ldi, qachon, nima yoqdi. Bu tuzilmani o‘z hikoyangizda ham ishlating.
scenes.say_uz: B Istanbulga bordi. Sayohat bir hafta davom etdi. Eng yaxshisi ovqat edi.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: Qiyinchiliklar
board: A: Did you have a good trip?
B: Not really. Our flight was late.
B: We waited for five hours, but finally we arrived.
scenes.say: Did you have a good trip? Not really. Our flight was late, and we waited at the airport for five hours. Oh no! What happened then? Finally, we arrived at midnight. The hotel was closed, so we slept in the lobby. But the next day was wonderful.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Bu safar sayohat muammoli bo‘lgan. Tinglang va sezing: so‘zlovchi avval muammoni aytyapti, so‘ng uni natija bilan bog‘layapti: “so”, “but”, “finally”. Bu bilan yaxshi hikoya hamisha muammoli voqeani ham qo‘shadi. Aynan muammolar haqida hikoya qilish eng qiziq eshitiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Sayohat yaxshi o‘tdimi? Unchalik emas. Reysimiz kechikdi va aeroportda besh soat kutdik. Voy! Keyin nima bo‘ldi? Nihoyat yarim tunda yetib keldik. Mehmonxona yopiq edi, shuning uchun lobbida uxladik. Lekin ertasi kuni ajoyib bo‘ldi.

scenes.title: Dialog 2 haqida savollar
board: 1) Why was the trip not good?
scenes.say: Why was the trip not good? How long did they wait? Where did they sleep?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: nima uchun sayohat yaxshi bo‘lmadi? Ikkinchi: ular qancha kutishdi? Uchinchi: ular qayerda uxlashdi? Javoblaringizda tartib so‘zi ishlating, masalan, “First…”, “Finally…”.
scenes.say_uz: Nima uchun sayohat yaxshi bo‘lmadi? Ular qancha kutishdi? Ular qayerda uxlashdi?

scenes.title: Dialog 2: javoblar
scenes.say: The flight was late. They waited for five hours. They slept in the hotel lobby.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: reys kechikkan. Ular besh soat kutishdi. Mehmonxona yopiq bo‘lgani uchun lobbida uxlashdi. Ko‘rdingizmi, “so” sabab-natijani bog‘ladi: mehmonxona yopiq edi, shuning uchun lobbida uxlashdi. Va “but” oxirida kontrastni berdi: lekin ertasi kuni ajoyib bo‘ldi. Hikoyada shunday bog‘lovchilarni ishlatish nutqingizni boyitadi.
scenes.say_uz: Reys kechikdi. Ular besh soat kutishdi. Ular mehmonxona lobbisida uxlashdi.

scenes.title: Sayohat haqida so‘rash
board: Did you have a good time?

examples.t: Did you have a good time?

scenes.say: Where did you go? Who did you go with? How was it? What did you like most? Did you have a good time?
scenes.say_native: Suhbatdoshning sayohati haqida so‘rash uchun bu beshta savolni biling. “Where did you go?” — qayerga bordingiz? “Who did you go with?” — kim bilan bordingiz? “How was it?” — qanday o‘tdi? E’tibor bering, “How was it?” da “did” yo‘q, chunki bu yerda “was” — “be” fe’li. “What did you like most?” — eng ko‘p nima yoqdi? Bu savollarga javob berish ham hikoyaning qismi.
scenes.say_uz: Qayerga bordingiz? Kim bilan bordingiz? Qanday o‘tdi? Eng ko‘p nima yoqdi? Vaqtingiz yaxshi o‘tdimi?

scenes.title: Hikoya qilishda tabiiy iboralar
scenes.say: So, we arrived late. Unfortunately, it rained all day. Luckily, we found a cafe. Anyway, it was a great trip.
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy hikoya uchun bir nechta so‘zlar: “So” va “Well” — gapni boshlash, “Anyway” — asosiy mavzuga qaytish. Yana ikkita muhim so‘z: “Unfortunately” — afsuski, “Luckily” — omadimizga. Ular voqeaga munosabat bildiradi va hikoyani jonli qiladi. Bu so‘zlardan keyin vergul bo‘ladi. Talaffuzda tez-tez qisqa pauza qiling, ohangni hikoya mazmuniga qarab o‘zgartiring: hayajonli joyda balandroq, afsuslanganda pastroq.
scenes.say_uz: Kech yetib keldik. Afsuski, kun bo‘yi yomg‘ir yog‘di. Omadimizga, kafe topdik. Baribir, ajoyib sayohat edi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: -ed qo‘shimchasi
scenes.say: Walked. Stayed. Visited. Wanted. Needed. Decided.
scenes.say_native: Hikoyada ko‘p muntazam fe’l bo‘ladi, ularning “-ed” qismi uch xil o‘qiladi. Jarangsiz tovushdan keyin “t”: walked, helped, watched. Jarangli tovushdan keyin “d”: stayed, travelled, arrived. Faqat “t” va “d” dan keyin alohida bo‘g‘in “id” bo‘ladi: visited, wanted, needed, decided. Xato qilish oson: “visited” ni “vizit” deb aytib yuborish. Uni uch bo‘g‘inli, ya’ni “VI-zi-tid” deb ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Walked. Stayed. Visited. Wanted. Needed. Decided.

scenes.title: Hikoyangizni rejalang
scenes.say: Plan your story. Where did you go? When? Who with? Three events. Two feelings. The best thing.
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘z hikoyangizni rejalang. Qayerga bordingiz, qachon, kim bilan? Uchta voqeani tartib so‘zlari bilan o‘ylang. Ikkita his-tuyg‘u so‘zi tanlang. Va eng yaxshi narsa nima edi? Agar yaqinda sayohat qilmagan bo‘lsangiz, o‘tgan yilgi biror dam olish kuni yoki xayoliy sayohatni tanlang. Hozir o‘ylash uchun vaqt beraman.
scenes.say_uz: Hikoyangizni rejalang. Qayerga bordingiz? Qachon? Kim bilan? Uchta voqea. Ikkita his-tuyg‘u. Eng yaxshi narsa.

scenes.title: Bir daqiqa gapiring
scenes.say: Now tell your holiday story. Speak for one minute. Start with: Last summer I went to...
scenes.say_native: Endi gapirish vaqti. Hikoyangizni bir daqiqa davomida ayting. Taxtadagi rejaga tayaning: boshlanish, to‘rtta tartib so‘zi, his-tuyg‘u va eng yaxshi narsa. To‘xtab qolsangiz, “well” yoki “so” deb davom eting. Xato qilsangiz, qaytib to‘g‘rilashga harakat qiling, lekin to‘xtab qolmang. Boshladik.
scenes.say_uz: Endi ta’til hikoyangizni ayting. Bir daqiqa gapiring. Boshlang: Last summer I went to...

scenes.title: Namuna hikoya
board: Last summer I went to Turkey with my sister.
First, we flew to Istanbul. Then…
The best thing was the food.
scenes.say: Last summer I went to Turkey with my sister. First, we flew to Istanbul. It was exciting! Then we visited the Blue Mosque and took a boat trip. Unfortunately, it rained one day, so we stayed in a cafe. Finally, we flew home. I was tired, but happy. The best thing was the food!
scenes.say_native: Namuna: o‘tgan yozda singlim bilan Turkiyaga bordim. Avval Istanbulga uchdik, bu hayajonli edi. Keyin Ko‘k masjidni ko‘rdik, qayiqda sayr qildik. Afsuski, bir kuni yomg‘ir yog‘di, shuning uchun kafeda o‘tirdik. Nihoyat uyga uchdik. Charchagan, lekin baxtli edim. Eng yaxshisi ovqat bo‘ldi. Siz ham hikoyangizni shunday tartib bilan qayta aytib ko‘ring.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan yozda singlim bilan Turkiyaga bordim. Avval Istanbulga uchdik. Bu hayajonli edi! Keyin Ko‘k masjidni ko‘rdik va qayiqda sayr qildik. Afsuski, bir kuni yomg‘ir yog‘di, shuning uchun kafeda o‘tirdik. Nihoyat uyga uchdik. Charchagan, lekin xursand edim. Eng yaxshisi ovqat edi!

scenes.title: Xatolarni toping
board: Last year I go to Samarkand. First we arrive at night. The hotel was boring. I was very excited about the old town.
scenes.say: Find the mistakes. Last year I go to Samarkand. First we arrive at night. The hotel was boring. I was very excited about the old town.
scenes.say_native: Bu hikoyada ikkita xato bor, ikkalasi ham fe’l shaklida. Matnni diqqat bilan tinglang va o‘tgan zamon haqida o‘ylang. Mehmonxona va eski shahar haqidagi gaplar esa to‘g‘ri, ularni o‘zgartirmang. Xatolarni toping va to‘g‘ri gapni ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Xatolarni toping. O‘tgan yili Samarqandga bordim. Avval kechasi yetib keldik. Mehmonxona zerikarli edi. Eski shahardan juda hayajonda edim.

scenes.title: Xatolar tuzatilishi
scenes.say: Last year I went to Samarkand. First, we arrived at night. The hotel was boring. I was very excited about the old town.
scenes.say_native: Faqat ikkita xato bor edi: “go” o‘rniga “went” va “arrive” o‘rniga “arrived”. “The hotel was boring” to‘g‘ri, chunki mehmonxona zerikarli deb tasvirlanyapti, ya’ni narsa. “I was excited” ham to‘g‘ri, chunki his qilgan odam men. Mehmonxona va eski shahar haqidagi gaplarni o‘zgartirmagan bo‘lsangiz, to‘g‘ri qildingiz: -ed va -ing shakllarini endi ishonch bilan ajratasiz. Va tartib so‘zidan keyin vergul qo‘yishni unutmang: “First, we arrived”.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan yili Samarqandga bordim. Avval kechasi yetib keldik. Mehmonxona zerikarli edi. Eski shahardan juda hayajonda edim.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: How was it? Did you have a good time?
scenes.say: Great job! You can now tell a story about a holiday in the right order and say how you felt.
scenes.say_native: Takrorlaymiz. Hikoya uch qismdan iborat: joy va vaqt, voqealar tartibi, his-tuyg‘u. Tartib so‘zlari: first, then, after that, finally. Voqealar o‘tgan zamonda, tavsif “was” va “were” bilan. Bog‘lovchilar: and, but, so, because. His-tuyg‘u uchun “-ed” va “-ing” farqi: I was bored, the tour was boring. Sayohat lug‘ati: flight, luggage, hotel, beach. Va suhbat uchun savollar: How was your trip? Did you have a good time?
scenes.say_uz: Barakalla! Endi ta’til haqida hikoyani to‘g‘ri tartibda aytib, o‘z his-tuyg‘ularingizni bildira olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
scenes.say: Your homework is to speak for one minute about your last holiday. See you next time!
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: oxirgi dam olishingiz haqida bir daqiqa gapiring. Telefoningizda yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida to‘rtta tartib so‘zi, kamida beshta o‘tgan zamon fe’li, ikkita his-tuyg‘u so‘zi va “was” yoki “were” bilan bitta tavsif bo‘lsin. Yozuvni tinglab, xatolaringizni aniqlang. Keyingi darsda kelajak rejalari va niyatlar haqida gapirishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: oxirgi ta’tilingiz haqida bir daqiqa gapiring. Ko‘rishguncha!

homework_uz: Oxirgi dam olishingiz haqida bir daqiqa gapiring va yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida to‘rtta tartib so‘zi, beshta o‘tgan zamon fe’li, ikkita his-tuyg‘u so‘zi va was yoki were bilan bitta tavsif bo‘lsin.

quiz.why_uz: Hikoya o‘tgan zamonda: went. Last summer oldida predlog yo‘q.
Finally — nihoyat. First — avval, then — keyin.

options: At the finally we went home.
quiz.why_uz: Finally gap boshida, predlogsiz va vergul bilan.

quiz.q: I was ___ after the long flight.
quiz.why_uz: Men charchadim: I was tired. Tired — his qilgan odam.
Be fe’li bilan did kerak emas: How was your holiday?

quiz.q: It was cold, ___ we wore coats.
quiz.why_uz: So natijani bildiradi: sovuq edi, shuning uchun palto kiydik.

quiz.q: How is “visited” pronounced at the end?
quiz.why_uz: T dan keyin ham, d dan keyin ham -ed alohida bo‘g‘in bo‘ladi: /ɪd/.
